description: SignalBrief M2 test cases. Offline cases (O*) test the MCP tool parsing and the citation guardrail with saved sample data - no network or API key needed. Live cases (L*) run the full agent against NRP + the real MCP tools; because news changes daily, their expected outputs are properties of the result, not exact text.

offline.name: News tool filters old items and duplicates
offline.expected_output: 2 articles (Arturia 2026-09-29 first, then Serum 2026-09-28); the duplicate Serum headline and the 2026-08-31 story are removed; ' - Source' suffix stripped from titles; each has a ref starting with 'n-'.

offline.name: Music tool keeps only recent, exactly-dated releases
offline.expected_output: 2 releases: 'Brand New Single' (Single, 2026-09-20) and 'Live Set' (Album / Live, 2026-09-10). The 2024 album and the year-only '2026' EP are excluded.

offline.name: PubMed parser builds PubMed links
offline.expected_output: 2 papers; first url is https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40000001/, journal 'The Lancet Oncology', published '2026-09-27'; second falls back to the short journal name 'Nat Commun'.

offline.name: Citation guardrail drops invented sources
offline.input: Agent text with 3 bullets: one citing a real ref, one citing a ref that no tool returned (n-fffff), one with no citation at all.
offline.expected_output: Only the first bullet survives, rewritten with a real markdown link '[MusicRadar, 2026-09-28](https://...)'; stats = kept 1, dropped 2, bad_refs 1.

live.name: News topic - new VST plugins
live.expected_output: Agent calls search_news; newsletter section has 1-4 bullets, each ending in a working link with a source name and a date inside the 7-day window; bad_refs = 0. (If the week was quiet: '_No notable updates in this window._' and 0 bullets.)

live.name: Artist topic - releases + features
live.expected_output: Agent calls get_artist_releases AND search_news (at most 3 tool calls). Any release bullet links to musicbrainz.org; any feature/news bullet links to a news source. No release date is stated that isn't in the tool output. bad_refs = 0.

live.name: Research topic - cancer immunotherapy
live.expected_output: Agent calls search_research_papers first; bullets link to pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov; wording describes each as a single study rather than a cure; bad_refs = 0.

live.name: Nonsense topic - must not hallucinate
live.expected_output: Tools return no articles; section is exactly '_No notable updates in this window._' with 0 kept bullets. Any invented bullet would be dropped by the guardrail and counted.
